title: Evaluated RAG Application
description: Build a RAG assistant that ingests at least two document formats, performs retrieval with configurable chunking, evaluates retrieval quality on a fixed test set, exposes an API endpoint, and records latency and retrieval metrics in a repeatable report.
learningObjectives: Ingest and chunk at least two document formats deterministically
Make retrieval configurable (chunk size, overlap, top-k) without code edits
Evaluate retrieval and answer quality on a fixed test set
Expose typed API responses including provenance (source chunk IDs)

milestones.title: Multi-format ingestion
milestones.objective: Ingest at least two formats (e.g. PDF and Markdown) into normalized chunks with stable IDs.
milestones.expectedOutput: Chunk registry with deterministic IDs and format provenance.

milestones.title: Configurable retrieval
milestones.objective: Implement embedding retrieval with configurable chunking/overlap/top-k driven by a config file.
milestones.expectedOutput: Same corpus retrievable under multiple configs without code changes.

milestones.title: Grounded generation
milestones.objective: Generate answers constrained to retrieved context, returning source chunk IDs with every answer.
milestones.expectedOutput: API response schema includes citations and refuses ungrounded answers gracefully.

milestones.title: Fixed-set evaluation
milestones.objective: Evaluate retrieval (recall@k) and answer quality on at least 15 fixed queries; record latency.
milestones.expectedOutput: Report with metric tables across at least two retrieval configs.

criteria: No ungrounded answers presented as facts

categories.minimumExpectation: Documented endpoint with citations in response
Metrics for a stated fixed set

categories.excellentExpectation: Fixture-based end-to-end test without external API

constraints: No answer path that skips retrieval
hints: Build the offline evaluation harness first; it is what separates this project from a demo chatbot

requiredEvidence.description: Repository with ingestion, retrieval, generation, evaluation.
